review: Pequod Heathcliff is an absolute monster of a tank ID. Beginning with the second part of his passive, he deals 1% more damage for every 1% HP he’s missing. Pequod Heathcliff has Max HP of 235, so he will deal 1% more damage for every 2.35 HP missing. This doesn’t have a cap either, so once you get him to low health, he’ll always just be a damage dealing monster. Pequod Heathcliff also has 1 Stagger Threshold, which is located at 80% HP, making it extremely easy to get his passive going and once it’s passed you’ll never need to worry about him staggering again. Going into the first part of Pequod Heathcliff’s passive, he can gain an extremely large amount of Offense Level Up and Defense Level Up, and the best part is that you can even use his counter, which is also incredibly strong, to get his passive going.
